Synopsis:
Shell acquires a 30% stake in BP's Conifer exploration prospect in the Gulf of Mexico and a 50% stake in BP's Tupinamba block in Brazil's Santos Basin. BP retains operatorship in both. The deal reflects a broader strategic pivot by both majors back toward oil and gas after years of renewables investment. BP's Brazilian upstream position is further underpinned by the Bumerangue discovery, holding 8 billion barrels of liquids.
